content: It looks like slop to me. Is it all AI-generated? The introduction to the paper is unreadable and the lean code shows several of the standard features of LLM-generated slop. You'll find that humans are very reluctant to read code generated by machines -- what's the point? Neither the machine nor the human who got the machine to write it can understand the feedback.

I tried to have look at your main theorem
https://github.com/nemustudies/attention-loop/blob/b44e92bf389d350650cff5b9db9d435c54601821/AttentionLoop/MainTheorem.lean#L337
but it doesn't make any sense to me.
